arabic text: Chehlum hai Azaadaron, Hussain Ibn-e-Ali ka
english translation text: Mourners, this is the Chehlum of Hussain ibn Ali

arabic text: Pursa do ay gham khwaaron Hussain Ibn-e-Ali ka
english translation text: Offer your condolences, people of grief for Hussain ibn Ali.

arabic text: Chokhat pe farishton ko jhukte huwe dekha\nDehleez pe Ahmed ko rukte huwe dekha\nQur’aan samajh kya hai, qaseeda hai inhi ka
english translation text: I saw angels bowing at his threshold.\nI saw Ahmad pause at his doorway.\nUnderstand what the Qur’an is—it is a praise-poem for him.

arabic text: Ye chaahen to sajda bhi barhjaate hain logon\nFitrus ko baal-o-par bhi miljaate hain logon\nDaaman na sameto tum, ye dar hai sakhi ka
english translation text: If he wills, people’s prostrations are accepted and raised.\nEven Fitrus regains his wings.\nDo not draw back your hands; this is the door of the generous one.

arabic text: Maan iski sayyada hai bahan saani-e-Zehra\nAaghoshe Muhammad ne ise naazonse paala\nRoko na ise logon ye maatam hai usi ka
english translation text: His mother is Sayyada, and his sister the second Zahra.\nMuhammad’s embrace raised him with tenderness.\nDo not stop this, people—this matam belongs to him.

arabic text: Zainab ne bichaaya tha haae farshe azaa ka\nIs tarah se chehlum tha shah-e-karbobalaa ka\nGhaazi ko bulaati thi jo tha sher-e-Ali ka
english translation text: Zainab spread the mourning floor.\nIn this way the Chehlum of the King of Karbala was held.\nShe called for Ghazi, Ali’s lion.

arabic text: Be jurm-o-khataa jiska janaaza tha zameen par\nInsaan to kujaa giryaa ye tha arsh bareen par\nZarron mein bikharta hai badan Ibn-e-Ali ka
english translation text: His innocent body lay without burial upon the earth.\nNot only humanity—the highest heavens wept.\nThe body of Ali’s son was scattered among the dust.

arabic text: Bosaaliya karte the kyun halqoom pe Ahmed\nKhanjar jo chalaa samjhi yehi zainab ham dard\nZainab ko zamaana wo yaad aaya nabi ka
english translation text: Why had Ahmad kissed that throat so often?\nWhen the blade moved, Zainab understood the painful secret.\nShe remembered the days of the Prophet.

arabic text: Zainab ne kiya giryaa kahaa mere baraadar\nTere baad mere bhaai looti meri bhi chaadar\nHar dard sunaati thi musibat ki ghari ka
english translation text: Zainab wept and cried, “My brother,\nafter you, even my veil was plundered.”\nIn that hour of calamity, she told him every pain.

arabic text: Teri pyaari Sakina bhi khafaa hogayi ham se\nZindaan basaaya or judaa hogayi ham se\nHaae mil na sakaa bhayya kafan teri kali ka
english translation text: Your beloved Sakina also became estranged from us.\nShe made the prison her home and then departed from us.\nBrother, your little flower did not even receive a shroud.

arabic text:
Ay "Bande Ali" kar tu is dar ki ghulaami
"Yawar" ko mile maula haan lafzon ki rawaani
Be shak ye aqeedah hai har zindaan dili ka
english translation text:
Bande Ali, remain a servant of this threshold.
Maula, grant Yawar fluency in words.
Without doubt,
this is the conviction of every living heart.
